title: First PS Plus Extra Game Removal for November 2026 Confirmed
text: First PS Plus Extra Game Removal for November 2026 Confirmed | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News PS5 PS4 PS Plus First PS Plus Extra Game Removal for November 2026 Confirmed GTA 5 says goodbye... again by Liam Croft 9 hours ago Share: If you want to replay GTA 5 before GTA 6 comes out via your PS Plus Extra subscription, you'll need to get a move on. The open worlder from Rockstar has been confirmed as leaving the service two days before GTA 6 comes out, on 17th November 2026. PS5 owners are actually receiving a system notification about the expiration date, floating the idea to members of playing GTA 5 before the sixth numbered instalment launches. The options you get are to either pre-order GTA 6 or play GTA 5, or I presume you can just back out of the screen. Either way, we now know GTA 5 will be taken off PS Plus Extra on 17th November. GTA V is the first game that is leaving the catalogue on Nov 17, right before VI releases. by u/Otherwise_Ninja_9699 in PlayStationPlus The thing is, though, it's almost certainly going to come back at some point. The two most recent Rockstar titles, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 , are constantly added to PS Plus Extra for short stints and then taken off the service. For example, since December 2023, GTA 5 has been on PS Plus Extra three times, and Red Dead Redemption 2 is also currently on its third cycle.
